sheet_from: Data/World5/Tile*.OZJ, from MuMain, decoded under an lt_ prefix: assets/textures is one flat pool, and all ten names are Lorencia's or the Dungeon's too. Slot 3 (TileGround02, a blue water sheet) is in World5 but no tile wears it, so it is not decoded. docs/lost-tower-port.md.
slot_note: World5 ships no TileGrass .OZT, so nothing grows here (terrain.py GRASS_BY_MAP[4] is empty). Seven flat floors at 1.7 m over a NoGround void drawn black; the lava pits are sunk to 0 and blocked.
material_note: Read off the art; the names lie. TileGrass01 is the tower floor, 65% of it: dark grey cracked slabs, flagstone. TileGrass02 is a carved green-grey tiling, TileRock02 the blue-and-gold diamond mosaic of floors 4 and 6, TileRock03 a dark teal rose-window floor: all laid stone, flagstone. TileGround01 is a black carved frieze, TileGround03, TileRock01 and TileRock04 cracked grey-brown stone: rock. TileWood01 is the tan dust laid over nearly everything: sand. TileWater01 is lava, orange-red under a dark crust, 10.5% of the map in the pits; it takes water so it slides as MU slides every TileWater01 tile, one sheet every twenty seconds (ZzzLodTerrain.cpp:1944-1948, 3594-3596), and the world sheet gives it no wet sheen.
